name: Plague Inc: The Board Game
description:
About This Game

The ultimate strategic game of infection, evolution and extinction. Start by infecting a single country. Evolve symptoms to become more powerful. Contaminate the Olympics, trigger a nuclear strike and more.

Each player is a deadly disease - compete with intelligent bots, friends or random people to be the first to wipe out humanity.

Designed by the creator of the mega hit video game Plague Inc. - this is the digital version of the best selling physical board game.

Question:

Is this really a video game of a board game of a video game?

Answer:

Yes it is! :)

I (James, the creator of Plague Inc.) originally made it to help test out new rules for the second edition of the print run - but had so much fun playing it digitally that I decided to infect everyone else with it too!

  • Play full single-player games with intelligent bot players

  • Full Legacy campaign with unique game modes, rules and rewards

  • Global Daily Challenge - see how your disease holds up 

  • Use the tutorial to learn the rules in a safe space

  • Try and beat the infamous PlagueBot game mode from the physical game.

Multiple online game modes let you share diseases with people all over the world.

  • Online multiplayer - jump into games fast.

  • Online Turn Based mode - take your time and play asynchronously

  • Use Legacy mode to turn games into a living world that is shaped by your actions

Have you always wanted to impress your friends with your nosebleeds, pustules and diarrhea? Show off your skin lesions?

Well this is your chance!

As well as playing all the normal multiplayer modes - you can take advantage of Same Device multiplayer to play on the big screen.
short_desc: Yes, this really is a video game of a board game of a video game! Spread across the world, mutate deadly symptoms and battle rival pathogens to wipe out humanity. A 1–4 player tabletop game of infection, evolution and extinction based on the smash hit with over 200 million players.
